# OG Images — WhatsApp Preview ke liye

## Required Files:
- og-home.jpg   (1200×630px) — Home page WhatsApp preview image
- og-about.jpg  (1200×630px) — About page WhatsApp preview image

## How to create:
1. Canva / Figma mein 1200×630px ka design banao
2. Export as JPG (< 300KB recommended)
3. Yahan paste karo: public/og/

## Naming Convention:
- Har page ka unique image hona chahiye
- File path config/seo.js mein BASE_URL ke saath define hai
